description: [forged] Offline validator for a South Korean Business Registration Number (사업자등록번호, format XXX-XX-XXXXX). Strips hyphens to 10 digits, applies weights 1,3,7,1,3,7,1,3,5 to the first 9 digits, adds floor(d9*5/10), and compares the mod-10 check digit to the 10th digit. (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

value.description: Business registration number, with or without hyphens (e.g. 123-45-67891)
